title: Add DataBackup.kt: Moshi-based export/import mapping and validation
description: Backup item data classes for each entity, decoupled from the Room entities via toBackupItem()/toEntity() extension mappers, a versioned DataBackupPayload bundling all three lists, and a DataBackupValidator object with serialize/parseJson/validate. This file has no DB/Context dependency -- pure mapping and JSON serialization; the actual read-from-DB / write-to-DB orchestration belongs in the UI/ViewModel layer, not here.
acceptance_criteria: @JsonClass(generateAdapter = true) data class ProfileBackupItem, MedicationBackupItem, DoseLogBackupItem mirroring each entity's fields as plain types (enums stored as their String name)

@JsonClass(generateAdapter = true) data class DataBackupPayload(val version: Int = CURRENT_BACKUP_VERSION, val profiles: List<ProfileBackupItem> = emptyList(), val medications: List<MedicationBackupItem> = emptyList(), val doseLogs: List<DoseLogBackupItem> = emptyList())

Extension functions Profile.toBackupItem(), ProfileBackupItem.toEntity(), Medication.toBackupItem(), MedicationBackupItem.toEntity(), DoseLog.toBackupItem(), DoseLogBackupItem.toEntity() using named arguments, converting ProfileKind/DosingMode via .name and valueOf()
object DataBackupValidator with a private Moshi instance (Moshi.Builder().addLast(KotlinJsonAdapterFactory()).build()) and a private adapter for DataBackupPayload
fun serialize(payload: DataBackupPayload): String returning adapter.toJson(payload)

fun parseJson(json: String): Pair<DataBackupPayload?, String?> that catches any exception from adapter.fromJson and returns a (null, errorMessage) pair on failure, or (null, message) if fromJson itself returns null, otherwise (payload, null)

fun validate(payload: DataBackupPayload): List<String> returning a list of human-readable problems: payload.version greater than CURRENT_BACKUP_VERSION, any profile with a blank name, any medication with a blank name or blank defaultDose -- empty list means valid
exact_code:
package com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data

import com.squareup.moshi.JsonClass
import com.squareup.moshi.Moshi
import com.squareup.moshi.kotlin.reflect.KotlinJsonAdapterFactory

const val CURRENT_BACKUP_VERSION = 1

@JsonClass(generateAdapter = true)
data class ProfileBackupItem(
    val id: Int,
    val name: String,
    val kind: String,
    val phoneNumber: String? = null,
    val colorTag: String? = null,
    val isArchived: Boolean = false,
    val createdAt: Long = 0L,
)

@JsonClass(generateAdapter = true)
data class MedicationBackupItem(
    val id: Int,
    val name: String,
    val dosingMode: String,
    val defaultDose: String,
    val minIntervalMinutes: Int? = null,
    val maxDailyDoses: Int? = null,
    val fixedTimesOfDay: String? = null,
    val notes: String? = null,
    val isArchived: Boolean = false,
    val createdAt: Long = 0L,
)

@JsonClass(generateAdapter = true)
data class DoseLogBackupItem(
    val id: Int,
    val profileId: Int,
    val medicationId: Int,
    val givenAtEpochMillis: Long,
    val doseAmount: String,
    val nextEligibleAtEpochMillis: Long? = null,
    val wasOverrideWarningAcknowledged: Boolean = false,
    val createdAt: Long = 0L,
)

@JsonClass(generateAdapter = true)
data class DataBackupPayload(
    val version: Int = CURRENT_BACKUP_VERSION,
    val profiles: List<ProfileBackupItem> = emptyList(),
    val medications: List<MedicationBackupItem> = emptyList(),
    val doseLogs: List<DoseLogBackupItem> = emptyList(),
)

fun Profile.toBackupItem() = ProfileBackupItem(
    id = id,
    name = name,
    kind = kind.name,
    phoneNumber = phoneNumber,
    colorTag = colorTag,
    isArchived = isArchived,
    createdAt = createdAt,
)

fun ProfileBackupItem.toEntity() = Profile(
    id = id,
    name = name,
    kind = ProfileKind.valueOf(kind),
    phoneNumber = phoneNumber,
    colorTag = colorTag,
    isArchived = isArchived,
    createdAt = createdAt,
)

fun Medication.toBackupItem() = MedicationBackupItem(
    id = id,
    name = name,
    dosingMode = dosingMode.name,
    defaultDose = defaultDose,
    minIntervalMinutes = minIntervalMinutes,
    maxDailyDoses = maxDailyDoses,
    fixedTimesOfDay = fixedTimesOfDay,
    notes = notes,
    isArchived = isArchived,
    createdAt = createdAt,
)

fun MedicationBackupItem.toEntity() = Medication(
    id = id,
    name = name,
    dosingMode = DosingMode.valueOf(dosingMode),
    defaultDose = defaultDose,
    minIntervalMinutes = minIntervalMinutes,
    maxDailyDoses = maxDailyDoses,
    fixedTimesOfDay = fixedTimesOfDay,
    notes = notes,
    isArchived = isArchived,
    createdAt = createdAt,
)

fun DoseLog.toBackupItem() = DoseLogBackupItem(
    id = id,
    profileId = profileId,
    medicationId = medicationId,
    givenAtEpochMillis = givenAtEpochMillis,
    doseAmount = doseAmount,
    nextEligibleAtEpochMillis = nextEligibleAtEpochMillis,
    wasOverrideWarningAcknowledged = wasOverrideWarningAcknowledged,
    createdAt = createdAt,
)

fun DoseLogBackupItem.toEntity() = DoseLog(
    id = id,
    profileId = profileId,
    medicationId = medicationId,
    givenAtEpochMillis = givenAtEpochMillis,
    doseAmount = doseAmount,
    nextEligibleAtEpochMillis = nextEligibleAtEpochMillis,
    wasOverrideWarningAcknowledged = wasOverrideWarningAcknowledged,
    createdAt = createdAt,
)

object DataBackupValidator {
    private val moshi: Moshi = Moshi.Builder().addLast(KotlinJsonAdapterFactory()).build()
    private val adapter = moshi.adapter(DataBackupPayload::class.java)

    fun serialize(payload: DataBackupPayload): String = adapter.toJson(payload)

    fun parseJson(json: String): Pair<DataBackupPayload?, String?> {
        return try {
            val payload = adapter.fromJson(json)
            if (payload == null) null to "Backup file was empty or malformed" else payload to null
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null to (e.message ?: "Failed to parse backup file")
        }
    }

    fun validate(payload: DataBackupPayload): List<String> {
        val errors = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (payload.version > CURRENT_BACKUP_VERSION) {
            errors.add("Backup was made with a newer version of the app and can't be restored here")
        }
        if (payload.profiles.any { it.name.isBlank() }) {
            errors.add("Backup contains a profile with a blank name")
        }
        if (payload.medications.any { it.name.isBlank() || it.defaultDose.isBlank() }) {
            errors.add("Backup contains a medication with a blank name or dose")
        }
        return errors
    }
}
